Rules at a Glance

Your WORD SCORE becomes damage. Armor blocks that damage before HP is lost.
On your turnOn the opening move, your word must cover the gold center medallion. After that, place your new tiles in one connected row or column, then tap Attack. Every word formed must be in the dictionary. All words formed earn their full letter and length points; shared letters count in each word.
ArmorBlue squares grant +8 Armor. Armor is a shield and is spent before HP.
Battle squaresGreen heals +5 HP, red doubles letter damage, blue fortifies.
ReforgeSpend HP to replace weak letters. Small Reforges keep your turn.
WinKnock the enemy to 0 HP or control 8 battle squares for Siege.

    How to Play Word Havoc

    1. Start at the centerYour opening word must cover the gold center medallion. After the first move, every word must connect to the existing board.
    2. AttackEvery horizontal and vertical word formed must be in the dictionary. All words formed earn letter and length points, including shared letters in each word. Your total WORD SCORE becomes damage, but Armor blocks damage before HP. Armor is your shield.
    3. HP is also moneyReforge 1 tile for 2 HP or 2–3 for 5 HP and keep your turn. An emergency full rerack costs 10 HP and ends it.
    4. Fight for battle squaresGreen heals +5 HP, red doubles letter damage, and silver grants +8 Armor. Armor is a shield that gets used up before HP.
    5. React to the opponentThe opponent’s newest tiles glow gold. Build through them for Counterstrike damage. Crossings and captures add extra tactical damage.
    6. Two ways to winKnock the opponent to 0 HP, or control 8 battle squares with a lead of 3+ and hold that Siege through their reply.
    7. Beat the clockStandard turns are 60 seconds. Timing out forfeits the turn and burns 5 HP. Blitz is 30; Strategy is 90.

    Online Safety

    Word Havoc has no chat. Objectionable words are filtered. You can still report or block the opponent in an invite match.

    Pass Device

    Hand the device to Player 2. Their rack is hidden until they begin.
